findings.claim: GM 2025 中國總銷量 1.9 百萬輛，市占 7.1%，較 2024 年增 0.1 個百分點
findings.excerpt: Our total vehicle sales in China were 1.9 million units resulting in a market share of 7.1% in the year ended December 31, 2025, representing an increase of 0.1 percentage points compared to the corresponding period in 2024.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：中國、印度等低成本製造商已在新興市場成為競爭者並進入成熟市場，對 GM 定價、份額造成並預期持續造成顯著負面影響；另有科技公司支持的新創與非傳統競爭者進入
findings.excerpt: Manufacturers in countries that have lower production costs, such as China and India, have become competitors in key emerging markets and have begun offering their products in established markets, as well as low-cost alternatives to established entry-level automobiles. These actions have had, and are expected to continue to have, a significant negative effect on our vehicle pricing, market share, and results of operations in these markets.

findings.claim: GM 2025 全球批發量 3,799 千輛，較 2024 的 4,010 千輛減少；GMI 由 547 降至 503 千輛
